page_title: CAG 0-1 ATA | Cagliari v Atalanta 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+2' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+1' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Adam Obert (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

85' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Marco Carnesecchi shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
83' Flag goes up against Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nadir Zortea walks off the pitch to be replaced by Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
77' Substitution. Razvan Marin (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Antoine Makoumbou walks off.
75' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
71' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Tommaso Augello is replaced by Adam Obert (Cagliari).
71' Substitution. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) in, Alessandro Deiola out.
71' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.
69' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the left post to safety.
66' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

66' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Raoul Bellanova. The score is now 0:1.
64' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Charles De Ketelaere will be replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Mario Pasalic.
59' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

59' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Alen Sherri pulls off a brilliant save. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) tries to nod in the rebound, but he is denied by a reflex save from the keeper.
58' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
58' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
56' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' A mistake by a defender gifts Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
53' Here's the change. Zito Luvumbo leaves the pitch and Mattia Felici (Cagliari) comes on as a substitute.
52' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
50' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Marten de Roon (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
47' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was!
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Isak Hien (Atalanta) is replaced by Berat Djimsiti.
46' The game is over for Marco Brescianini (Atalanta). Marten de Roon comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Gian Piero Gasperini gives a chance to Ademola Lookman and Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) is off.
46' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' The linesman raises his flag. Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) is adjudged offside.
43' Sebastiano Luperto (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
43' Marco Carnesecchi (Atalanta) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
42' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him!
40' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.

39' Marco Carnesecchi makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) inside the box and he drills a strike goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the target. The referee points to the corner flag and Cagliari will take a corner.

39' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

39' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
34' Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
34' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
32' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
28' Luca Pairetto interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari).
27' A pass from Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
24' Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.
22' Flag up against Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
22' Atalanta take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' That was close by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post.
15' A pass into the penalty area from Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) is intercepted by the defence.
13' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) heads on.
10' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
10' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. It will be a corner kick for Atalanta.
10' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
3' Excellent touch by Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
2' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
1' That's a well-taken pass by Ederson (Atalanta). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Atalanta will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Luca Pairetto.
